source.title: Secrets of Elune
source.description: The moonwells contain Elune's blessing, but they are also a symbol of the connections we all share. Take this phial of water from Stormwind's moonwell to the one in Auberdine, on the shores of Kalimdor. As the waters combine, so too will your spirit combine with that of the kaldorei.
source.objective: Bring the phial to Syrnoya at the Auberdine moonwell.
source.completion:
<Syrnoya adds the water of the phial to the moonwell>

Elune's favor is with you, <name>. When your travels take you to other moonwells, stop for a moment and you may receive her blessing.
